_about: Levels, stat points and what each stat does. Every level after the first gives one point to spend in the Character menu (2016 design: health, farting power, jump power, headbutt power). Stats start at 1 and go to 5. xp_to_reach[n] is the total XP needed for level n + 1.

fart.name: Farting power
fart.about: Longer gas boosts, a bigger cloud, and enough stink to scare a tiger from rank 2.

jump.name: Jump power
jump.about: Higher jumps, for the later stages where gravity pulls harder.

headbutt.name: Headbutt power
headbutt.about: Breaks tougher things: rocks at rank 1, cactus and bears from rank 2.
